verses.text: K'inalok ay junok te' makte' kalnel tiknaik, ta ay junok winh tz'och t'a yol te', palta tato manhok t'a sti' te' tz'och winh, wal yel elk'um winh syal chi'.
Haxo winh tz'och t'a sti' te' smakte' nok' kalnel chi', haton winh chi' stanhwumal nok'.

Haxo winh swaymitan nok' kalnel chi', a winh sjakan te' makte' chi' t'a winh stanhwumal nok' chi'. Haxo nok' kalnel chi', k'aynak nok' yet' winh stanhwumal chi'. Yojtak sb'i junjun nok' winh. Ha winh sjakanelta nok'.
Slajwi sjakanelta nok' skalnel winh chi', sb'ab'laj winh yuj nok', tz'och tzak'an nok' yuj winh, yujto k'aynak nok' yet' winh.
Palta k'inalok ay junok winh manh k'aynakok nok' yet'ok, tonhej tz'el lemnaj nok' t'a winh, yujto manh ojtakab'ilok sjaj winh yuj nok', xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh fariseo chi'.
Ha jun ch'oxnab'il ix yal Jesús chi', maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' winh tas syalelk'ochi.
Ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb' winh: --Wal yel swal t'ayex, icha yaj sti' te' smakte' nok' kalnel, icha chi' waji.

Ay heb' ix b'ab'laj ja t'ayex ayik manto in jawok, niwanok yalnakoch sb'a heb' kolwajumal. Icha junok elk'um tz'och t'a te' makte', icha chi' yaj heb' smasanil. Palta haxo heb' yik Dios, max yak'och spensar heb' t'a heb'.
Ha in tik, lajan in yet' sti' te' makte' chi'. Ha heb' tz'och t'ayin, ol kolchaj heb'. Icha nok' kalnel tz'och t'a yol smakte', tz'elxita nok', sb'at wa nok', icha chi' yaj heb'.
Ay heb' icha junok elk'um sjawi, syelk'al milan nok' kalnel chi' heb'. Palta a in tik, ix in ja wak' sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, yik wach' te niwan swach'k'olal Dios ol scha heb'.
Ha in tik, lajan in yet' junok tanhwum kalnel te wach'. Ha junok tanhwum kalnel wach' chi', sb'ek sb'a scham yuj nok' skalnel chi'.

Ay b'aj tonhej stupji junok winh stanhwan nok' kalnel, manh toxonok tanhwum kalnel winh, manh yikok nok' winh. Tato sk'och nok' okes t'a nok', syaktejkan nok' kalnel chi' winh sch'okoj, sb'at winh elelal, yujto manh yikok nok' winh. Haxo nok' okes chi' sja juknajok, schianb'at nok' kalnel chi', saklemkanb'at nok'.
Tz'el lemnaj winh, yujto majan yaj winh, yujto manh yikok nok' winh, malaj tz'och nok' t'a winh.

Ha in tik, lajan in yet' junok tanhwum kalnel te wach'. Ha heb' wiko', ichato in kalnel yaj heb'. Ha in Mam yojtak in. Hanhejtona' in, wojtak pax in Mam chi'. Icha wojtak in b'a yet' in Mam chi', icha pax chi' wojtak in b'a yet' heb' wik chi'. B'ekan in wak'an cham in b'a yuj heb'.

Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' ol in ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, palta manh ketisraeloklaj heb'. Yowalil ol in molb'ejkot heb'. Ha heb' chi', ol in sk'anab'ajej heb'. Junnhej ol aj heb' smasanil, a in ol in tanhwej heb'.
Xajan in yuj in Mam, yujto b'ekan in k'o'ol in chami yik ol in pitzwokxi.

Ha in tik, b'ekan in k'ol in chami, yujto icha chi' in gana. Malaj mach tz'ik'anek' in k 'inal tik. Ha in swala' to tzin chami, hanhejtona' in swala' to tzin pitzwixi, yujto icha chi' yaj yalankan jun scheknab'il in Mam t'ayin, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh.
Ayik ix yalan juntzanh tik, ix laj spojan sb'a heb' aj Judea chi' junelxo yuj tas ix yal chi'.
Ay nanhal heb' ix halani: --¿Tas yuj tzeyak'och he chikin t'a tas syal jun winh tik? Ina ayoch jun enemigo t'a winh, yuj chi' aykot t'a sjolom winh, xchi heb'.
Palta ay nanhalxo heb' ix halani: --Tato ayoch junok enemigo t'a winh, ¿tom syal yalan winh icha chi'? Ha junok enemigo, ¿tom syal sb'o'an sat junok mach max yaltaxon yilani? xchi heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti' ix uji jun tik, haton t'a stiempoal si'ik, stiempoal pax yoch sk'inhal stemplo Dios t'a Jerusalén.
Haxo Jesús wan sb'eyek' t'a jun stentail sti' yamak'il templo chi' skuch yik Salomón.
Haxo heb' aj Judea ayek' ta', ix och hoyan heb' t'a spatik Jesús. Ix yalan heb': --¿B'ak'inhto ol al sjichanil t'ayonh? Tato yel Cristo ach, al t'ayonh tiknaik, xchi heb' t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix tak'wi t'a heb': --Ina toxo ix wal t'ayex, palta max in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol. Ha juntzanh satub'tak tzin ch'oxo', yujnhej spoder in Mam tzin ch'oxo'. Yujnhej juntzanh chi' scheklaji mach in.
Palta a ex tik, max in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol, yujto manh ex wikok icha walnak t'ayex junel.
Ha heb' wiko', syak'och schikin heb' t'ayin. Ha inxo tik, wojtak heb'. Icha nok' kalnel tz'och tzak'an yuj stanhwumal, icha chi' tz'ajoch tzak'an heb' wu'uj.
Ha in swak' sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi', manhxa b'ak'inh ol satel heb'. Malaj mach syal yik'anel heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Ha in Mam, te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh smasanil. Ha ix ak'an heb' t'ayin. Malaj mach syal yik'anel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' in Mam chi'.
Ha in tik, lajan in yet' ko Mam Dios, yujto junnhej waj yet'ok, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ix laj sik'ancha'anh k'e'en k'e'en heb' yik sjulancham heb' yalani.
Palta ix yalanxi Jesús t'a heb': --Tzijtum tas wach' ix in k'ulej t'a he kal yuj spoder in Mam. ¿Tas yuj junok ijan tzin he julchamok? xchi t'a heb'.
--Manh yujok junok wach' ix a k'ulej tzach ko julchamok, palta yujnhej to tzach b'uchwaj t'a Dios. Ha ach tik anima achnhej, palta ina tzaloch a b'a Diosal, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi t'a heb': --Ha t'a ch'anh ley aykan t'ayonh tz'ib'ab'ilkani to ha Dios alannak: Junjun ex, Dios ex, xchi t'a ley chi'.
Kojtak to a tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios chi', max yal sko mak'ek'i. Ha heb' ab'annak slolonel chi', alchajnak heb' diosal.
Okxom in tik, ha Dios sik'jinak in eli, ix in schekankot t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj tzeyala' to tzin b'uchwaj t'a Dios, ayik ix walani to Yuninal in Dios?
Tato max in k'ulej icha tas sk'ulej in Mam chi', manh in eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol.

Palta a in tik, yel wan in k'ulan icha sk'ulej in Mam chi'. Yuj chi', wach'chom max eyak'och t'a he k'o'ol tas swala', palta ak'ek in och t'a he k'o'ol yuj juntzanh tzin k'ulej tik, yik ol nachajel eyu'uj to ayoch ko Mam Dios t'ayin, ayin pax och t'ay, xchi Jesús chi' t'a heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yak'lej heb' syaman junelxo, palta ix skol sb'a t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'axpajxikan ek' t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán. Haxo b'aj yak'nak bautizar heb' anima winhaj Juan ix aji.
Tzijtum anima ix k'och ta'. Ix laj yalan heb': --Ha winhaj Juan, malaj b'aj ix sch'ox junok tas satub'tak winh, palta jantaknhej tas ix yal winh yuj Jesús tik, te yel, xchi heb'.
Ha t'a jun lugar chi', tzijtum heb' ix ak'anoch Jesús t'a sk'o'ol.
